ordered_diagnoses: Multiple Hereditary Infundibulocystic Basal Cell Carcinomas

s1.syndrome_frame: Multiple skin-colored papules on the face and vulva with a gradual increase in number over time
salient_findings: Multiple dome-shaped, skin-colored papules on the face and vulva
Lesions first appeared around 50 years of age and gradually increased
Family history of similar facial papules
key_facts: Patient is a woman in her 60s
Multiple dome-shaped, skin-colored papules are present on the face and vulva
Lesions first appeared around 50 years of age
Lesions gradually increased to approximately 60
Patient has a medical history of meningioma
Family history is notable for a daughter with similar facial papules
No palmar or plantar pits were observed
Histopathology showed buds and cords of basaloid cells enclosing small cystic spaces
Clefting between tumor aggregates and the surrounding stroma was focally evident
Whole-exome sequencing revealed a conserved splice-site mutation in the SUFU gene
